visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a light blue denim jacket and purple over-ear headphones, stands in a brightly lit train station platform. Behind him is a green-and-white station sign for Ebisu and Shibuya. He looks directly at the camera with a calm expression. (2) Close-up shot of a station sign that displays 'Shibuya' in Japanese and English, with directional arrows. The background shows the blurred architecture of the station ceiling and lighting. (3) The man is at an outdoor bus stop at dusk. He is looking down at his smartphone held in both hands. Streetlights and passing traffic are visible in the background against a dimming sky. (4) Close-up of a white ramen bowl filled with many halved soft-boiled eggs with bright orange yolks, arranged in a circular pattern on top of a dark broth. A hand wearing a black ring is seen steadying the tray. (5) The man is seen from behind in a brightly lit arcade or pachinko parlor. He is energetically moving his arms in a rhythmic way toward a large, colorful gaming machine with flashing lights. (6) A nighttime shot of the Tokyo Skytree, illuminated with a red and purple light pattern against the black sky. (7) Inside a moving bus at night, the man sits and looks out the window, holding his phone. He has his purple headphones around his neck. Orange interior handrails are visible. (8) The man walks away from the camera through a busy, brightly lit pedestrian shopping street at night. Other people are walking in both directions. (9) On a city street at dusk, the man performs a playful little jump or dance step toward the camera. His facial expression is lighthearted. Cars and buildings are visible in the background.
